cifake.publication: CIFAKE: Image Classification and Explainable Identification of AI-Generated Synthetic Images, IEEE Access, 2024
cifake.protocol: Original test split remains held out after exact duplicate cleaning; validation is derived from original training images. POC is a smaller balanced subset.

progan.publication: CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot... for now, CVPR, 2020
progan.protocol: A custom stratified 70/15/15 pilot split from the released validation archive. This is not the original benchmark training protocol. The current downloaded release contains 8000 image entries; the paper describes 4000 validation images.

genimage.publication: GenImage: A Million-Scale Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Image, NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks, 2023
genimage.community_mirror_verification: Pinned revision, same 207 paths and byte sizes as the official Drive snapshot; downloaded SHA-256 checked against mirror metadata, not official publisher hashes.
genimage.protocol: Source acquisition only as of 2026-10-28. Preserve supplied train/val roles; full-data preparation and eight-generator training/evaluation integration are pending. Do not substitute Tiny GenImage results.

tiny_genimage.publication: Derived from GenImage: A Million-Scale Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Image, NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks, 2023
tiny_genimage.protocol: Original training groups retained, supplied validation groups split into validation/test, and decoded-pixel duplicates grouped globally. All released prepared variants are balanced. This community subset excludes SD1.4 and is not the complete official GenImage protocol.
